children: Select Water Solutions agreed to acquire Pilot Water Solutions, a private water midstream company with primary operations in the Delaware Basin.
The equity and cash deal, which is set to close in the fourth quarter, is valued at $700 million, plus $15 million of additional potential contingent cash consideration, Select Water said Thursday.
Select Water shares gained 14% to $22.20 in after-hours trading.

Pilot Water's infrastructure platform has about 2.7 million barrels per day of active permitted disposal capacity, 0.9 million barrels per day of undeveloped permitted disposal capacity and more than 700 miles of pipeline infrastructure.
More than 80% of its annual revenue is backed by long-term contracts with an average tenure of more than seven years.

The deal includes $600 million in cash and $100 million in shares of Select. The number of shares to be issued will be determined by dividing $100 million by the 30-day volume-weighted average price of Select's stock prior to closing.

In connection with financing the deal, Select has entered debt commitment letters with JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America. Select plans to fund the cash portion of the deal with cash on hand, borrowings under debt financing and potentially other debt financing.
The sellers have the right to an additional $15 million, contingent on the satisfaction of certain operational milestones expected in early 2027.

The sellers will also receive a true-up payment in cash if the 30-day average share price as of the six-month anniversary of the closing date is lower than the 30-day average price at the closing date.
